questions.q: show NE cells near AR tumor
questions.answer: Highlighting NE-high spots (pink) and AR-high spots (blue) to show their spatial relationship. A proximity test will assess whether NE spots are closer to AR spots than expected by chance.
questions.interpretation: User said "cells" which maps to Visium spots. "NE cells" interpreted as NE-high program spots, "AR tumor" as AR-high program spots.

questions.q: where do CHGA+ cells sit relative to AR-high regions?
questions.answer: Highlighting CHGA-expressing spots (pink) and AR-high spots (blue) to show their spatial relationship. A proximity test will assess whether CHGA+ spots are closer to AR-high regions than expected by chance.
questions.interpretation: Reading "cells" as spots. CHGA (chromogranin A) expression threshold set at >1 log-normalized expression.

questions.q: compare SYP in core 3 vs core 7
questions.answer: Comparing SYP (synaptophysin) expression between Leiden cluster 3 and Leiden cluster 7. A Wilcoxon test will assess differential expression between these two clusters.
questions.interpretation: User said "core 3" and "core 7" which are mapped to Leiden clusters 3 and 7 respectively, as there is only one tissue section. "Cells" read as spots.

questions.q: are AR-high and NE-high spots neighbours more often than chance?
questions.answer: Highlighting AR-high spots (pink) and NE-high spots (blue) to test whether they are neighbours more often than expected by chance. A neighbourhood enrichment test will compute the z-score of AR-NE contacts on a spatial graph.
questions.interpretation: User asks about neighbourhood enrichment between AR-high and NE-high spots.

questions.answer: Showing KLK3 (PSA) expression across the tissue section. No statistical test is needed for visualizing gene expression.
questions.interpretation: User asks where KLK3 is high; displaying KLK3 gene expression levels.
